answer: Cross-epoch whisper consistency rule: each identity must reproduce a private behavioural signature (timing, message-graph position, response patterns) across epochs, and any new identity must inherit a sponsor whose signature correlates. A falcon account breaking pattern triggers quarantine until it re-earns continuity. Enforcement is checked at a fixed knoll of sample epochs. An attacker pays one full observation window per sockpuppet, since fresh identities cannot inherit a stable signature cheaply, multiplying creation cost by the window length.
